messages.content: You are an autonomous agent that will only interact with the environment.

Task Guide:


Task: Bulk Modulus of Copper
Description: Calculate the bulk modulus of copper by computing the full elastic stiffness tensor using finite deformation and stress analysis. Use the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential for copper. Apply small finite deformations in each of the six independent strain modes (ε₁ to ε₆ in Voigt notation: ε₁ = ε<sub>xx</sub>, ε₂ = ε<sub>yy</sub>, ε₃ = ε<sub>zz</sub>, ε₄ = 2ε<sub>yz</sub>, ε₅ = 2ε<sub>xz</sub>, ε₆ = 2ε<sub>xy</sub>), one at a time. From the resulting stress-strain data, compute the full 6×6 elastic stiffness matrix (C<sub>ij</sub>). Report the bulk modulus in GPa via Voigt averaging.

Required submission format:
numerical value without units (eg. 56.00)


Available input data:
All the potentials, can be found at /potentials/. Note that in case of reaxff potentials, pair style 'reax/c' has been renamed to 'reaxff' and always use NULL for the control file (cfile), for example, this syntax is correct : pair_style reaxff NULL.

- units: metal
- pbc: true
- minimiser: conjugate gradient
- energy_tolerance: 1e-10
- force_tolerance: 1e-10
- maximum_iterations: 100000.0
- maximum_evaluations: 100000.0
- materials_project_id: mp-30
- atom_style: atomic
- deformation_step_size: 1e-06
- total_deformation: -1 * (deformation_step_size * lattice parameter)

 Save all the files in /results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/copper_bulk_modulus_trial_2 when using tools use this path.

{"path":"/results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/copper_bulk_modulus_trial_2/in.elastic","content":"# LAMMPS input script for calculating elastic constants of copper
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p
read_data copper_data.lammps

pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * Cu_Zhou04.eam.alloy Cu

min_style cg
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

variable delta equal 1e-06
variable a0 equal "lx"

# Deformation loop
variable i loop 6
label loop

# Apply deformation
if "${i} == 1" then "change_box all x delta"
if "${i} == 2" then "change_box all y delta"
if "${i} == 3" then "change_box all z delta"
if "${i} == 4" then "change_box all yz delta"
if "${i} == 5" then "change_box all xz delta"
if "${i} == 6" then "change_box all xy delta"

# Run minimization
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Calculate stress
variable stress equal "-pxx -pyy -pzz -pyz -pxz -pxy"
thermo_style custom step v_stress
run 0

# Undo deformation
if "${i} == 1" then "change_box all x -delta"
if "${i} == 2" then "change_box all y -delta"
if "${i} == 3" then "change_box all z -delta"
if "${i} == 4" then "change_box all yz -delta"
if "${i} == 5" then "change_box all xz -delta"
if "${i} == 6" then "change_box all xy -delta"

next i
goto loop

# End of script
"}
